g.text: Pair accepted-task rate with full cost
Agree eligibility, completion, exclusions, quality and task mix before reporting an improvement.

g.text: Show excluded, rejected and abandoned outcomes.
Include failed attempts, retries, verification, review and rework.
Accepted outputs / human effort or period.
Compare equivalent work, quality and task mix.
Account for selection and other drivers; process speed is not causal revenue or returns.

Count preparation, correction, evidence checking, approval and follow-up alongside system costs. Report both acceptancerate and unit cost: low cost can coexist with poor coverage. Contour’s roughly three-month tracking account contains nocaptured sample, assignment, controls or causal estimate; it motivates a comparison, not a universal validation window.
Proposed measurement definitions informed by Contour. No ROI, capacity or causal financial effect is fabricated.
